programme.desc: 在尚比亚最大和最野生的保护区卡富埃国家公园深处,来自「尚比亚肉食性动物计划」的生物学家和兽医团队争分夺秒地拯救和保护非洲的顶级掠食者。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #4
programme.desc: 欢迎来到印度- 充满异国的动物和异国的战事。猴子打得尘土飞扬,印度黑羚在开阔的平原上全面开战,孔雀哥儿开屏比拼: 这些多姿多彩的战斗衬得上充满活力的土地。

programme.title: 深潜北美 #5
programme.desc: 参与莉兹最惊险刺激的大西洋任务——与公牛鲨进行自由潜水。探索充满神秘氛围的墨西哥湾湿地沼泽,那里栖息著饥饿的鳄鱼、机敏的鳄龟,还有虽然细小却无比强韧的沙丘老鼠,牠们的存在对维持海岸稳固起著不可或缺的作用。

programme.title: 深潜北美 #6
programme.desc: ​裹上厚厚保暖衣物,莉姿向北出发,标记鲨鱼行踪,亲眼目睹海冰逐渐融解的缓慢、令人警醒的消逝。​在「熊监狱」里度过一段时光,与那些被捕捉后暂时安置的北极熊共处,牠们因为冰封猎场缩减,被迫闯入人类城镇寻找食物,为求一餐,走上危险之途。

programme.title: 珊瑚之城 #3
programme.desc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存从来不是理所当然,唯有适应,否则就得灭亡。​高于常态的温度使得入秋冷却变得更加困难,生存难度随之攀升。暂住于小丑鱼一家和他们那位海葵房东之间的共生之家,再看看清洁鱼如何替魔鬼𫚉提供一场犹如水中温泉会馆般的疗愈服务。

programme.title: 明猩学园 #5
programme.desc: 搜寻失踪的孤儿拉黑伊,并见证害羞的鲁姆巴在筑巢课上,尝试使用她虚弱的左手。见证年轻的黛丽拉在课堂上如何教训布米,并看看班尼和瓦伦蒂诺能否合格,最终赢得自由。

programme.title: 明猩学园 #6
programme.desc: 恭喜明猩学园的应届毕业生,并见证他们的茁壮成长!跟随车队前往典礼现场,见证团队向每一位踏上新旅途的明猩朋友作真挚告别,然后举行热闹的毕业庆祝活动!而莫莉和布米也成功升班。

programme.title: 动物解码 #3
programme.desc: 从超远距离的鲸歌,到大象的亚声,再至墨鱼皮肤上闪烁的讯息,动物们有著令人难以置信的调情、战斗、聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套动物语言等待我们解码。

programme.title: 灵长大地 #6
programme.desc: 进入南非的荒野,近距离观察这个大陆最容易被误解的灵长类动物之一。跟人类一样,这些灵长类动物具有独特的个性,与家人和朋友都有著强烈的联系。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #5
programme.desc: 前往世界各地的海岸线,那里的食物和栖息地冲突导致了绝望的生存之战。目睹企鹅们从愉悦的性情转变为凶残的愤怒,进入一头保护幼崽的座头鲸的世界。

programme.title: 明猩学园 #5
programme.desc: 搜寻失踪的孤儿拉黑伊,并见证害羞的鲁姆巴在筑巢课上,尝试使用她虚弱的左手。见证年轻的黛丽拉在课堂上如何教训布米,并看看班尼和瓦伦蒂诺能否合格,最终赢得自由。

programme.title: 珊瑚之城 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​当寒冬降临之际,沁入骨髓的寒意让原本热闹喧腾的珊瑚礁世界趋于沉静。随著镜头悠然缓行,你将与礁鲨一同漫游,与章鱼共度水下时光;还会探访一处奇妙的珊瑚绿洲,静静地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上。别错过条纹蛇鳗高超的「身分窃取」本领: 牠能巧妙伪装成凶猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​冲过昆士兰东南地区,在繁殖与捕蛇的季节逐步升温时,观看阿黛儿与米克迎战一条东部棕蛇,这是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同时史都与丽芙则与一条地毯蟒纠缠搏斗。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​随著春季的蛇潮展开,跟随丽芙与史都一起,他们在工地现场拦截两条为争夺交配权而决斗的公棕蛇,这是一场激烈的争斗,一场关乎交配资格的争战。退后站观,观看丹与洁丝从一条蟒蛇手中救出鸡群,而米克与阿黛儿则追捕一条失控的绿树蛇。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭于昆士兰沿海的混乱景象与喧嚣之中,杰丝勇敢面对她内心的恐惧,追逐一只攀爬至树上的蕾丝蜥蜴,而那棵树上还栖息著活跃繁忙的蜂巢。观看斯图小心翼翼地将一条被困在篱笆之间的东方褐蛇救出,并观察米克为惊慌不安的屋主捕捉那条滑溜难抓、灵活的巨蟒。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潜入狭小紧迫的空间之中,钻入温室的底部结构,并进入紧张刺激的救援现场,捕蛇人勇敢面对一条长达六英尺、极度有毒的褐蛇。随后观看斯图与莉芙将威胁到屋主宠物安全的沿海巨蟒小心搬迁至安全地点。

programme.title: 动物知心友 #1
programme.desc: 跟随一只鸡穿梭整个美国,并到英国拜访一个栖居于花园的老鼠家族。正所谓以毒攻毒,见证人们如何在蜘蛛的帮助下克服蜘蛛恐惧症、与守护著地球上最后两只北部白犀牛的志愿者同行、并为更多跨物种的友情而喝采。

programme.title: 灵长大地 #7
programme.desc: 随着人类的活动范围不断扩张,非洲的狒狒必须适应求存。走访整个非洲大陆,观察牠们如何在面对家族存亡的关键时刻,形成牢不可破的社群连系,并在不断变化的环境中挣扎求存。

programme.desc: 随着人类的活动范围不断扩张,非洲的狒狒必须适应求存。走访整个非洲大陆,观察牠们如何在面对家族存亡的关键时刻,形成牢不可破的社群连系,并在不断变化的环境中挣扎求存。

programme.title: 明猩学园 #5
programme.desc: 搜寻失踪的孤儿拉黑伊,并见证害羞的鲁姆巴在筑巢课上,尝试使用她虚弱的左手。见证年轻的黛丽拉在课堂上如何教训布米,并看看班尼和瓦伦蒂诺能否合格,最终赢得自由。

programme.title: 捍衞太平洋 #3
programme.desc: 海洋哺乳类救援队帮助迷路的海龟回家。一头巨大的海狮被发现被十字弓击中,需要吊车才能将牠带到救援中心。马堤博士帮助一只果蝠应付晚年,还有帮助一只好斗的独眼海豹游向自由。

programme.title: 珊瑚之城 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​当寒冬降临之际,沁入骨髓的寒意让原本热闹喧腾的珊瑚礁世界趋于沉静。随著镜头悠然缓行,你将与礁鲨一同漫游,与章鱼共度水下时光;还会探访一处奇妙的珊瑚绿洲,静静地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上。别错过条纹蛇鳗高超的「身分窃取」本领: 牠能巧妙伪装成凶猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​冲过昆士兰东南地区,在繁殖与捕蛇的季节逐步升温时,观看阿黛儿与米克迎战一条东部棕蛇,这是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同时史都与丽芙则与一条地毯蟒纠缠搏斗。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​随著春季的蛇潮展开,跟随丽芙与史都一起,他们在工地现场拦截两条为争夺交配权而决斗的公棕蛇,这是一场激烈的争斗,一场关乎交配资格的争战。退后站观,观看丹与洁丝从一条蟒蛇手中救出鸡群,而米克与阿黛儿则追捕一条失控的绿树蛇。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭于昆士兰沿海的混乱景象与喧嚣之中,杰丝勇敢面对她内心的恐惧,追逐一只攀爬至树上的蕾丝蜥蜴,而那棵树上还栖息著活跃繁忙的蜂巢。观看斯图小心翼翼地将一条被困在篱笆之间的东方褐蛇救出,并观察米克为惊慌不安的屋主捕捉那条滑溜难抓、灵活的巨蟒。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潜入狭小紧迫的空间之中,钻入温室的底部结构,并进入紧张刺激的救援现场,捕蛇人勇敢面对一条长达六英尺、极度有毒的褐蛇。随后观看斯图与莉芙将威胁到屋主宠物安全的沿海巨蟒小心搬迁至安全地点。

programme.title: 明猩学园 #6
programme.desc: 恭喜明猩学园的应届毕业生,并见证他们的茁壮成长!跟随车队前往典礼现场,见证团队向每一位踏上新旅途的明猩朋友作真挚告别,然后举行热闹的毕业庆祝活动!而莫莉和布米也成功升班。

programme.title: 宁格鲁: 澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #3
programme.desc: 了解宁格鲁的保护性奇迹如何激励人类帮助地球摆脱气候破坏的影响。参观废弃的捕鲸站与其他遗迹,这些都表明只要我们拥有改变的决心,我们就会有改变的工具。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #6
programme.desc: 加拿大的夏季短捉,时间紧迫- 任何时候都是战斗的好时机。宏大的北方为野牛、秃鹰和北极熊提供了动物王国中激战的战场。

programme.title: 野战攻略 #1
programme.desc: 雅拉国家公园的森林是神秘懒熊的家。这种动物生性害羞,很少被看见及拍摄。加入野生动物影片制作团队,跟著他们揭开前所未见的神秘懒熊生活和行为。

programme.title: 野战攻略 #2
programme.desc: 大象中途之家 (Elephant Transit Home) 来了新成员: 一只生病的小象在自然保护区附近被抛弃,这是人类和大象争夺空间下的又一个受害者。深入了解在普鲁图·费南多博士的领导下,如何以创新的方式努力结束这场冲突。

programme.title: 野战攻略 #3
programme.desc: 兰卡猕猴隐藏在斯里兰卡的森林中。作为岛上的土生动物,这群活泼的群居猴子在世上独一无二。牠们是有史以来最长的灵长类动物研究项目的核心。胡夫间铁达时博士致力了解牠们复杂的社会。

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #1
programme.desc: 在海陆相连的公园中,自然元素相互结合,创造出美妙的多样性。可乐色的水使森林变得翠绿和茂密。火与风促进多样性的增长,岩石形成了众多面貌的海岸线。生命在这里茁壮成长 - 从壮丽到奇异,这是花园大道国家公园。

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #2
programme.desc: 在克留格尔国家公园北部,赖以维生的元素就是水。在炎热和干旱的土地上,一条丝带在荒野中切割出可靠的路线。它是不论大小所有生物的生命线。

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #3
programme.desc: 伟大的奥兰治河有著56米高壮观的奥赫拉比斯瀑布。奥赫拉比斯源于「oukurubes」这个词,在南玛改的土著语言中意思是「雷霆之地」,这片土地是一个苛刻和阳光充沛世界的中心,充满绚丽色彩和雷鸣般的咆哮。

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #4
programme.desc: 地球上从最小到最大的任何生物都离不开食物、水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些动物极力求生,而另一些则茁壮成长。所有动物都为寻找生存所需展开旅程,牠们必须决定在何时何地移动来获取成功这就是赞比西河下游的神奇世界。

programme.title: 美国在野四季录 #4
programme.desc: 南非的冬天带来干旱、冰雪和风暴。在此生活的动物必须与天气、土地和彼此竞争。猎豹、海豹、秃鹰和狐獴。雨水终于结束旱季,并引发了生命的爆发性发展。

programme.title: 动物解码 #1
programme.desc: 从超远距离的鲸歌,到大象的亚声,再至墨鱼皮肤上闪烁的讯息,动物们有著令人难以置信的调情、战斗、聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套动物语言等待我们解码。

programme.title: 动物解码 #2
programme.desc: 从超远距离的鲸歌,到大象的亚声,再至墨鱼皮肤上闪烁的讯息,动物们有著令人难以置信的调情、战斗、聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套动物语言等待我们解码。

programme.title: 动物解码 #3
programme.desc: 从超远距离的鲸歌,到大象的亚声,再至墨鱼皮肤上闪烁的讯息,动物们有著令人难以置信的调情、战斗、聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套动物语言等待我们解码。

programme.title: 动物知心友 #1
programme.desc: 跟随一只鸡穿梭整个美国,并到英国拜访一个栖居于花园的老鼠家族。正所谓以毒攻毒,见证人们如何在蜘蛛的帮助下克服蜘蛛恐惧症、与守护著地球上最后两只北部白犀牛的志愿者同行、并为更多跨物种的友情而喝采。

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #1
programme.desc: 前往桑布鲁,看看在当地的一条河流干涸后,女族长阿纳斯塔西亚如何领著牠的象群向北方前进。然后来到纳波西奥,看看猎豹母亲库莱塔如何躲避狡猾的猎狗群。最后,在莱基皮亚,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窝。

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #2
programme.desc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然间使河水满溢的倾盆大雨带来的欢喜。在狮子杀死猎豹的一只幼崽后,为库莱塔的丧子之痛而哀悼。并在野狗菲尼克斯与凶狠的猎狗对峙时观看实时战况。

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3
programme.desc: 跟随阿纳斯塔西亚的足迹,牠的象群因为保护两只珍贵的小象而兵分两路,而猎豹库莱塔则为牠剩下的幼崽夺回领地。尘土散去,雨水开始滋润干涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯寻找新伴侣的旅程。

programme.title: 成为大象: 瑞提提的孤儿们 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社区经营的瑞特提大象庇护所,在这里,人类的代理妈妈们透过玩耍教导小象如何在野外生存,并细心地照顾与陪伴牠们成长。与那只失去象鼻的小象隆乌洛建立情感连结,同时了解为什么六岁的小象凯勒勒那场神秘的疾病,可能会让牠的重返野外之路被迫延迟。

programme.title: 骄傲之地: 野地回春
programme.desc: 一个澳洲家庭在南非的一个古老狩猎牧场进行修复。他们的目标是重建过度生长的栖息地,建立生态旅游牧场,并允许包括猎食者在内的自然野生动植物搬回家。

programme.title: 野生守卫队 #1
programme.desc: 这是尚比亚两只黑犀牛的关键时刻。 四岁的雌性押臣和十四岁的公牛肯高是复杂的重置任务的核心,这是宏伟的拯救物种计划的一部分。

programme.title: 野生守卫队 #2
programme.desc: 在尚比亚最大和最野生的保护区卡富埃国家公园深处,来自「尚比亚肉食性动物计划」的生物学家和兽医团队争分夺秒地拯救和保护非洲的顶级掠食者。

programme.title: 追梦女赛车手 #1
programme.desc: 业余赛车手萧咏雯 (Vivian Siu) 梦想征战澳门格兰披治大赛。她自费且经验极少,迅速跃升至 F4,成为中国锦标赛首位女车手。她面临著技术和筹集关键资金的巨大挑战。

programme.title: 追梦女赛车手 #2
programme.desc: 澳门大赛从赛程中移除,Vivian 的赛车之旅遭遇挫折,梦想面临终结。即使有一丝希望,她仍需在数周内完成寻找赛车、车队和搭档车手的艰钜任务。

programme.title: 李小龙: 战士之道
programme.desc: 李小龙,荷里活电影的标志性人物,武术先驱,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友。《武者之路》全面审视,由最亲近的人讲述李小龙的传奇。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #4
programme.desc: 大象团队在今集迎来令人震惊的消息,兽医们担心他们救助的一只小企鹅,我们也了解到如何真正需要一个社区来为动物园提供食物。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #5
programme.desc: 小企鹅史拿帕在今集回到领地,但牠会被接纳吗?兽医团队准备治疗苏门答腊虎沙利,动物园则帮助拯救濒危的本地物种。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #6

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #5
programme.desc: 小企鹅史拿帕在今集回到领地,但牠会被接纳吗?兽医团队准备治疗苏门答腊虎沙利,动物园则帮助拯救濒危的本地物种。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #6
programme.desc: 有蹄类动物团队在今集准备接生,我们遇到最长寿动物之一,奥克兰动物园协助拯救濒危的巨物。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #7
programme.desc: 长颈鹿婴儿遇上族群,动物园的五个水獭兄弟正在移动,冷血动物团队正寻找隐藏的宝藏。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #8
programme.desc: 动物园兽医们在今集竭力拯救地球上最濒危的鸟类之一,过程使他们十分焦虑;而冷血动物团队正在野生的南岛执行任务。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #9
programme.desc: 今集,动物园在沼泽森林欢迎两只鳄鱼,新的东南亚栖息地开张,团队准备为南方白犀牛宝宝庆生。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #4
programme.desc: 座头鲸回归阿拉斯加丰饶的食堂,三文鱼则回到河流产卵。不过,牠们必须跟饥饿的棕熊讨一条生路。

programme.title: 蜥蜴的生存之道
programme.desc: 认识科学家们认为是生命及如何进化的故事的关键生物: 安乐蜥。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临著一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #2
programme.desc: 随著春季来临,日照变长,气温上升。不过,阿拉斯加只有短暂的春季。动物只有两个月时间来觅食和组织家庭,还要避开猎食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #3
programme.desc: 阿拉斯加已进入夏季。这为世上最大规模之一的阿拉斯加三文鱼迁徙准备了舞台。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #4
programme.desc: 座头鲸回归阿拉斯加丰饶的食堂,三文鱼则回到河流产卵。不过,牠们必须跟饥饿的棕熊讨一条生路。

programme.desc: 认识科学家们认为是生命及如何进化的故事的关键生物: 安乐蜥。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防风少年— #3
programme.desc: 以打架闻名的强者全聚集在一年一班。无视于一旁慌张的榆井及冷静旁观的苏枋隼飞,樱与被他惹怒的杉下京太郎展开了一场豪迈的战斗。但防风铃的总长梅宫一高分贝的声音打断了他们的攻防。当樱等人神情紧张地仰望著扩音器时,等到的却是梅宫出乎意料的一番话。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防风少年— #4
programme.desc: 奉行力量至上的「狮子头连」是个在邻地称王,以橘色刺绣外套为其特征的集团。樱为了保护镇上高中生而与他们发生冲突,其副头领十龟条因此对他宣战。当他和柊登马一起向梅宫报告时,不仅没被责备,还受到感谢。就在此时,突然有道无邪但异样的声音响彻校园。

programme.title: 克拉龙人拉格纳 #1
programme.desc: 笨拙的狩龙人少年拉格纳,与以压倒性猎龙数闻名的天才少女蕾欧妮卡搭档讨伐龙族。但上级龙古流姆威迪,远强过他们以往所讨伐的龙,终结了这样的日常。面对强敌,闪过拉格纳脑海的是烦恼他多日的恶梦,获取最强力量却无值得守护的事物,充满绝望与孤单的自己。

programme.desc: 以打架闻名的强者全聚集在一年一班。无视于一旁慌张的榆井及冷静旁观的苏枋隼飞,樱与被他惹怒的杉下京太郎展开了一场豪迈的战斗。但防风铃的总长梅宫一高分贝的声音打断了他们的攻防。当樱等人神情紧张地仰望著扩音器时,等到的却是梅宫出乎意料的一番话。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防风少年— #4
programme.desc: 奉行力量至上的「狮子头连」是个在邻地称王,以橘色刺绣外套为其特征的集团。樱为了保护镇上高中生而与他们发生冲突,其副头领十龟条因此对他宣战。当他和柊登马一起向梅宫报告时,不仅没被责备,还受到感谢。就在此时,突然有道无邪但异样的声音响彻校园。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #103
programme.desc: 等级4的恶魔在亚连和利娜莉的攻击下看似已被击倒,教团内部顿时弥漫如释重负的气氛。然而并未彻底死去的等级4恶魔虽然身体遭亚连的剑贯穿,却露出狰狞的表情起身袭击,朝难掩惊讶的亚连等人不断释放强力能量弹。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防风少年— #5

programme.title: 克拉龙人拉格纳 #2

programme.desc: 拥有压倒性强大力量的等级4恶魔将亚连逼至无法战斗,之后开始进攻教团本部内。科穆伊和教团成员对紧急广播宣布的「等级4恶魔侵袭」一事感到惊愕。科穆伊急忙准备结界装置以迎击恶魔,然而等级4的恶魔随后出现在他面前。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #102
programme.desc: 遭等级4恶魔袭击的教团陷入毁灭危机。利娜莉为了打破僵局,决定将INNOCENCE植入自己体内。与科穆伊一起度过的怀念回忆在她脑海中浮现后消失。她想起为了自己而抛弃一切的科穆伊,想报恩的她毫不犹豫地吞下了INNOCENCE。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #103

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #5
programme.desc: 阿久津在魔界上司丽兹的训练下终于获得了信心。为了使莉莉堕落,他开始采取行动。对于以闪闪动人的帅气模式诱惑自己的阿久津,莉莉亦以软萌女主角的模式反击。阿久津看穿莉莉的所有攻击,并逐一闪避过去……处于压倒性劣势的莉莉,决定要孤注一掷。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #6
programme.desc: 莉莉一整晚都未能睡著,因为她脑里全都是昨晚和阿久津之间所发生的事。不胜睡魔的她,在上课时不禁打起了瞌睡。阿久津甚至还出现在了她的睡梦中。在这场如恋爱游戏般的梦境中,她认为她或许能找到攻略阿久津的线索……莉莉打算推进游戏中的故事,然而……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #7
programme.desc: 莉莉在与「素体」的战斗中精疲力竭,并失去了意识。阿久津抱起了她,并把她送回了她的房间。阿久津本欲离去,却被意识模糊的莉莉抓住衣角,无法动弹。无奈之下,他只好坐在房间读角落。过了一阵子,莉莉醒了过来。她发现阿久津已经睡著了,于是她便悄悄地接近了他的身边。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #8
programme.desc: 夕香等人看到了阿久津和莉莉一起从公寓中出来。尽管他们迫切地想要澄清他们并没有共度一晚,但班上的同学却没有那么容易放弃追问……这时候,夕香对阿久津提出了一个出乎意料的建议……她居然邀请他去约会……!?

programme.title: 重启人生的千金小姐正在攻略龙帝陛下 #10
programme.desc: 「军神千金」吉儿被未婚夫王太子杰拉尔德陷害入狱并因此丧命,但回过神来竟发现自己回到与未婚夫初见的那晚。为了避开人生最糟选择,吉儿决定要与未来的暴君,实则纯真的邻国皇帝哈迪斯结婚,并立志要帮他重新做人。重启人生的千金,她的大逆转剧就此开幕。

programme.desc: 拥有压倒性强大力量的等级4恶魔将亚连逼至无法战斗,之后开始进攻教团本部内。科穆伊和教团成员对紧急广播宣布的「等级4恶魔侵袭」一事感到惊愕。科穆伊急忙准备结界装置以迎击恶魔,然而等级4的恶魔随后出现在他面前。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #102
programme.desc: 遭等级4恶魔袭击的教团陷入毁灭危机。利娜莉为了打破僵局,决定将INNOCENCE植入自己体内。与科穆伊一起度过的怀念回忆在她脑海中浮现后消失。她想起为了自己而抛弃一切的科穆伊,想报恩的她毫不犹豫地吞下了INNOCENCE。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #103
programme.desc: 等级4的恶魔在亚连和利娜莉的攻击下看似已被击倒,教团内部顿时弥漫如释重负的气氛。然而并未彻底死去的等级4恶魔虽然身体遭亚连的剑贯穿,却露出狰狞的表情起身袭击,朝难掩惊讶的亚连等人不断释放强力能量弹。

programme.title: 排球少年!! 第一季 #1
programme.desc: 日向第一次参加排球比赛,对手就是影山的学校,一场充满热忱的竞争就此展开。

programme.title: 排球少年!! 第一季 #2
programme.desc: 日向加入乌野高中排球社,想要击败他的宿敌影山,却发现影山现在成为他的队友。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #5
programme.desc: 阿久津在魔界上司丽兹的训练下终于获得了信心。为了使莉莉堕落,他开始采取行动。对于以闪闪动人的帅气模式诱惑自己的阿久津,莉莉亦以软萌女主角的模式反击。阿久津看穿莉莉的所有攻击,并逐一闪避过去……处于压倒性劣势的莉莉,决定要孤注一掷。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #6
programme.desc: 莉莉一整晚都未能睡著,因为她脑里全都是昨晚和阿久津之间所发生的事。不胜睡魔的她,在上课时不禁打起了瞌睡。阿久津甚至还出现在了她的睡梦中。在这场如恋爱游戏般的梦境中,她认为她或许能找到攻略阿久津的线索……莉莉打算推进游戏中的故事,然而……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #7
programme.desc: 莉莉在与「素体」的战斗中精疲力竭,并失去了意识。阿久津抱起了她,并把她送回了她的房间。阿久津本欲离去,却被意识模糊的莉莉抓住衣角,无法动弹。无奈之下,他只好坐在房间读角落。过了一阵子,莉莉醒了过来。她发现阿久津已经睡著了,于是她便悄悄地接近了他的身边。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #8
programme.desc: 夕香等人看到了阿久津和莉莉一起从公寓中出来。尽管他们迫切地想要澄清他们并没有共度一晚,但班上的同学却没有那么容易放弃追问……这时候,夕香对阿久津提出了一个出乎意料的建议……她居然邀请他去约会……!?

programme.title: 地球大神秘
programme.desc: 从世界各地搜集到数以百计奇异事物内容,都是无法以一般人接受的观点加以解释,除非这个世界在科学理论上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天5 我为上帝精彩过
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下错车,弄得满身伤痕、万劫不复,惟有祂并不介意我们的过去,愿意领我们走向美好的将来。《如果还有明天5我为上帝精彩过》,深入中国广西山区孤儿院,记录残障青年在信仰中找回尊严和盼望的故事。摄制队再远赴南半球,见证澳洲天生失明女歌手及轮椅上的妈妈,突破身体局限活出主爱无限;还有美国摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑台湾苦著名女艺人纪宝如及香港饱历沧桑的妈妈Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 主日讲坛-中国基督教播道会同福堂
programme.desc: 中国基督教播道会同福堂 讲题:你的时间用在那里? 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪。透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意。

programme.title: 专题讲座:张路加牧师宣教培灵系列
programme.desc: 华人福音工作是现今最大的禾场,我们需要怎样的装备,将福音的种子带到华人当中?就让拥有丰富牧会经验的张路加牧师,教大家好好装备,在福音的道路上奔跑吧。

programme.title: 喜乐婆婆会客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子乔妈,人称「喜乐婆婆」,一生经历操练出一套喜乐心得,她更请来一众嘉宾好友,分享人生中大小风浪,靠著的是同出一辙的喜乐秘诀,在节目中娓娓道出那份属天的快乐。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 铁证待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之铁证待判》继续以游历的方式,走进荷兰、土耳其、约旦、敍利亚,涉及接近50个地点,超过30个已经发生嘅神迹预言、传奇故事,以考古和实证,重新解构连科学都不能解释的千古谜团。 历年来有无数的考古学家和世界知名的纪录片频道,为了解开上帝藉著摩西施行神迹分割红海这个历史迷团,他们都不惜花上大量的财力物力,研发新科技,要到红海的海底寻找历史证据。这集创世电视会直撀约旦,踏足每一处地方,搜罗各种铁证,带你经历摩西如何施行神迹分割红海,从埃及法老王手中,带领以色列人平安走过红海,离开埃及。

programme.title: 《天下华人唱出好诗歌大赛》大赛
programme.desc: 由影音使团、香港福音盛会、华福会香港区委会、以勒基金主办,创世电视首届「天下华人唱出好诗歌」大赛,冠军即将诞生。世上最美的声音,是生命重生的声音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位参加者,一年训练、成长、比并、同行,要成为祝福城市的好声音。

programme.desc: 「超阔银幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大众化的福音主题」,加上「诚意的款待」会产生极致的「福音体验」

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天5 我为上帝精彩过
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下错车,弄得满身伤痕、万劫不复,惟有祂并不介意我们的过去,愿意领我们走向美好的将来。《如果还有明天5我为上帝精彩过》,深入中国广西山区孤儿院,记录残障青年在信仰中找回尊严和盼望的故事。摄制队再远赴南半球,见证澳洲天生失明女歌手及轮椅上的妈妈,突破身体局限活出主爱无限;还有美国摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑台湾苦著名女艺人纪宝如及香港饱历沧桑的妈妈Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 葛培理牧师特辑
programme.desc: 节目记录葛培理布道团最新福音事工,并葛培理牧师70年来布道的足迹及对世界各地的贡献,让我们面对不同的世情,仍然把握机会传福音。

programme.title: 圣地流动教室-以色列破谜之旅
programme.desc: 通晓中西方历史、文学、艺术、民间传说的学者吴宗文牧师,以及主持梁艺龄,透过镜头带著电视观众,去到圣地各站游历,呈现出新旧约的《圣经》典故、历史文献的记载、相关的犹太传说和传统习俗,而更重要是从耶稣和初期信徒的记载,带出人生的重要特质,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
高朋满座#12粤
programme.desc: 蕙婷吹嘘成「新一代学生偶像」，有朋被封为「新一代厨神」，自从得奖后生活大大改变，反而迷失在虚名中。坊间又选出另一名厨神，有朋成为过气厨神，反令他倍感轻松。有朋发现即使有没厨神身分，他也只是煮饭公而已。

programme.title: 锦心似玉#23粤普
programme.desc: 令宜醒来后收拾行囊出发山东，出发前给十一娘写了和离书，若府中人发现了刺伤一事，十一娘只要拿出和离书离府便是；太夫人问十一娘刺伤令宜的原因，十一娘向太夫人请罪，此时管家报告令宜因在灾区救百姓而葬身火海…

programme.title: 阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 苦瓜虽有苦涩味，但绝不影响同煮食材的味道，故被称为君子瓜。鼎爷在顺德府右市场选购优质苦瓜，并一应阿谭的为食要求，分别以蒸、煎两种烹调方法，奉上双重口感的「酿苦瓜」。苦瓜原条酿入馅料，更可保留甘香味道？酿豆卜是家庭常吃小菜，只要巧加心思，豆卜也可变成花！鼎爷带阿谭到访工场，试食新鲜滚热辣的即炸豆卜；及后将虾仁、猪肥肉等馅料酿入豆卜，即成香脆松软的「百花豆卜」。阿谭还用部份虾胶，做成香煎虾饼。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 小儿湿疹是婴幼儿常见的皮肤问题，在3个月大时已有机会发作，有甚么病征？儿科医生详析湿疹小朋友经常晚上搔抓的原因，而情况容易引致更大影响。医生还带来治疗资讯，并释除大众对使用类固醇药物的疑虑。视障艺术家经历多次挫折，成功克服阅读困难考入大学，且听他分享个中故事。他同时致力宣扬触感艺术，身体力行推动伤健共融，也会细说何谓触感艺术作品。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，傅季馨师傅炮制一道「韩式焖牛尾」。

programme.title: 医医，我不想再病了粤
programme.desc: 运动后立即进食不利减肥？林盛斌(Bob)与太太，关曜俊与何远东两组同样认为视乎食物种类而定，惹来「抄袭」疑云，看哪组能够从医生手上取分。两组分别设计运动后便当，远东、曜俊再分享减肥餐心得。传闻「防弹咖啡」有助减肥，嘉宾试饮后找出两样关键材料。甚么是「生酮饮食法」？医生提醒当中的注意事项。为何厌食症患者背脊会出现生毛现象？Bob自揭曾试过极端减肥法。另外，中医带来减肥食疗汤水，还考嘉宾的用秤技巧。

programme.title: 陪著你走#5粤
programme.desc: 言重摸衣袋时找到旧屋门匙，回旧居看到雪糕车，不禁想起他十三岁那年的旧事。天从和导生来到公园边吃雪糕边看韩剧，言重经过坐到天从身旁一同观看。看完剧集后天从才发觉有人在旁，她向言重道明自己失明，只是靠听。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 山田扮鬼脸逗得大家笑成一团，回家后更拿来火男面具助阵，小丸子家中没面具，于是尝试自行制作。小丸子尝试把蜜瓜籽拿去种，小衫待种子发芽后讨了部分蜜瓜苗回去种，并把小丸子视为亲密好友。

programme.title: Hands Up粤 及 成语动画廊粤
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」再次展开，收看节目的小朋友是否已准备好一同接受训练？平衡力训练的大部份动作需单脚站立进行，大家要收紧腹部核心肌群，努力维持身体稳定。其中一个挑战更要把一樽水放在头顶，并尝试不让水樽掉落。另会利用橡筋带锻练上肢肌力，动作包括二头弯举、三头肌屈伸等，做法怎样？这集还会播放AI生成动画《三只山羊》的下半部份。山羊大哥与二哥面对怪兽，最终能否顺利过桥？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 考试将至，阳葵和美月正努力温习。这天刚巧是偶像公主空间维护日，无法进行偶像公主活动。与此同时，艾姆们在偶像公主空间回想主人的往事。不论是阳葵出道，与Ruby=Lazuli对决，到遇上阿纺，都令艾姆相当回味。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝粤
programme.desc: 在九十年代，香港有罕见的四胞胎出生，这对新手父母顿时成为新闻人物。究竟照顾多胞胎有何挑战，父母对这个「甜蜜的负担」，又有何看法？新闻掏宝和大家重温1990年专题。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 招商局集团特约：天气报告粤
东张西望粤
programme.desc: TVB一连两天举行职艺员盘菜宴，直击首晚盛况。节目曾多次报道运输署派筹乱象，当局其后更改程序以期改善，效果却不似预期。有人为取筹通宵排队，更有中介公开出售筹号牟利！摄制队派员实测，竟耗近八小时，才成功到柜台办理。面对此情况，据指当局会取消现场派筹措施……汪明荃、蔡少芬、朱茵等演员出席剧集《风华背后》煞科庆功宴，并分享合作感受，众星同场恭贺黄宗泽荣封「视帝」。此外，这集亦带来有助舒缓咳嗽的健康资讯。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2719粤
programme.desc: 大四喜遭生产商欺骗，出售的应援物品质素低劣，引起粉丝不满，只好设法安抚群情，期望平息事件。树根收到来自「黑粉」的死亡恐吓，幸而无恙。其余成员纵未受滋扰，却各自出埠暂避风头。敢威安排虹豆沙汤远保护树根，沙汤远成功化解「黑粉」的各种恶作剧。树根对沙汤远关怀备至，令树仁心生妒意，决意使计对付沙汤远。阴差阳错下，沙汤远反而发现「黑粉」行踪，成功捉拿该人，其身分更出乎众人意料……

programme.title: Return 关节筋肌配方呈献 :守诚者#18粤PG
programme.desc: 无独有偶，三号车巡逻时救下一位身中枪伤的外籍人士，凶手再次指向南亚裔。连续数件南亚裔针对白人金融高管的枪击案件，疑似与金融狙击案有关，何浩辉跟邵峰分析，认为过于巧合。此时又发生一起南亚人枪杀白人案件。

programme.title: 宿敌契约#13粤普PG
programme.desc: 慕容曜与一笑摊牌，他警告一笑如果她向随歌说出真相，他安排在宫中的人就会对陛下动手，随歌将会失去一切。一笑放走如嫣，劝她离开玉京城好好生活，怎料如嫣还是意图自杀，一直暗中跟随她的一笑及时出手相救…

programme.title: 寻欢作乐的姐姐粤
programme.desc: 随着女性经济力量攀升，针对女性群的吃喝玩乐体验应运而生。麦玲玲先与何依婷、林凯恩、何沛珈、刘晓昆结伴同游上海，再会合吴若希、戴祖仪、游嘉欣玩转深圳、广州，以女性角度带大家「寻欢作乐」，见识时下备受姊妹们追捧的潮流文化与玩意，探索网红打卡美食和景点，迎接多个「第一次」！「姐姐们」组团北上尝鲜，猛男烤肉、帅哥居酒屋、小鲜肉按摩店、硬核健身、一对一辣身舞、格斗酒吧等非凡体验，如何冲击姐姐「底线」？

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 招商局集团特约：天气报告粤
名媛望族#18粤
programme.desc: 警察打捞不到木水尸体，小由晕倒。医生向小由谈到小茹不能再说话时，被小茹听到，小茹欲自杀。启燊发现小由姊妹不在，目睹她们跳海。尔嫣与老太太见面，原来她早知老太太是日辉。子君与菲菲看见尔嫣与日辉在一起。

programme.title: 医医，我不想再病了粤

programme.title: 陪著你走#6粤

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 时下流行穿热裤，丸尾妈妈其实一直向往穿热裤，但在家中试穿时却被丸尾看到，后者大感震惊。爷爷打算丢掉没用的旧物，小丸子助他分类后，爷爷却表示不舍得丢，嫲嫲指出旧物是打开记忆的锁匙。

programme.title: Hands Up粤 及 成语动画廊粤
programme.desc: 提起一种御寒能力高的动物，可能是得意的企鹅。「Artspiration」，绘画导师指导大家在画纸中间画一只「大鸡蛋」，再逐步加上不同颜色的眼睛、嘴巴、肚腩与四肢。想画作背景变得更丰富，导师与主持玲玲姐姐有甚么好提议？这次「开心SHARE」的主题是「我的兴趣」，小朋友纷纷传来相片，展示玩单轮单车、滚轴溜冰、跳芭蕾舞的型格一面。新加入节目任主持的Emily姐姐，原来是位跳舞老师，她还打算学习甚么运动？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: Ruby=Lazuli在偶像公主大赛赢得蔷薇大赛造型，准备穿上它做一场特别演唱会。可是，在演唱会当天，樱与珠希竟无法换上造型登台。蔷薇大赛造型对她二人说，以她俩目前的状态，是无法穿上这套造型，而且原因就在珠希心内

programme.title: 财经新闻粤

programme.title: Return 关节筋肌配方呈献 :守诚者#19粤PG

programme.title: 宿敌契约#14粤普PG
programme.desc: 平城仍然昏迷，凌峰为免随歌因平城病情被栽赃，道出平城十五年前已患有绝症，庄慎知悉后却无一丝喜悦之情，命侄子庄明竭力寻找让平城醒来之法，并请慕容仲到府商议…慕容仲离开庄府后被一笑掳走，慕容曜知悉后大怒。

programme.title: 寻欢作乐的姐姐粤
programme.desc: 随着女性经济力量攀升，针对女性群的吃喝玩乐体验应运而生。麦玲玲先与何依婷、林凯恩、何沛珈、刘晓昆结伴同游上海，再会合吴若希、戴祖仪、游嘉欣玩转深圳、广州，以女性角度带大家「寻欢作乐」，见识时下备受姊妹们追捧的潮流文化与玩意，探索网红打卡美食和景点，迎接多个「第一次」！「姐姐们」组团北上尝鲜，猛男烤肉、帅哥居酒屋、小鲜肉按摩店、硬核健身、一对一辣身舞、格斗酒吧等非凡体验，如何冲击姐姐「底线」？

programme.title: 季节限定 秋冬粤
programme.desc: 节目首集，林韦辰、谭永浩、黄庭锋和林伊丽前往大帽山之北的梧桐寨游山玩水，一览香港少有的瀑布群美景。行山过后，众人走进以高速输送带运送食材的特色火锅店补充体力；再请来「厨房男神」炮制「薯不简单」的紫薯盛宴。位于锦上路的隐世菠萝园适合一家大小游玩，四位主持入内亲亲小动物、采摘新鲜菠萝、品尝菠萝美食，还跟导师学做凤梨酥。另有女中医师介绍主治气虚的八珍汤，以及煮成膏方的步骤，让繁忙的都市人调理身体。

programme.title: 季节限定 秋冬粤
programme.desc: 秋高气爽，最适合进行户外活动。年轻主持们登上马鞍山昂平，大玩滑翔伞，一尝飞翔的自在感觉！他们随后跟随辰哥哥品尝滋味蟹宴，见识当造「幻之蟹」。天气干燥容易喉咙痛，汤水达人传授「海星青榄汤」，既可抗炎消肿，亦具滋润喉部之效。2017年秋冬衣著流行甚么颜色？众人得到时装设计师指点，换上「至潮」服饰，走进潮流尖端！玩乐用餐过后，辰哥哥带队到访远离繁嚣的书屋，感受片刻的宁静，并细味洛神花茶的清香，洗涤心灵。

programme.title: 世界独特社区粤普

programme.title: 芬兰潮什么粤
programme.desc: 瑞典小镇某酒店设有全世界最大的桑拿空间，芷珮焗到一身汗，随即挑战当地人必做的冰池体验，冷热交替好刺激！设于怀旧小屋的咖啡店，还售卖有机家品？入住河畔渡假村，芷珮品尝木火烤鱼、参观博物馆，见识渔村文化；浸着户外热水浴赏极光，更是难得经验！服饰店结合咖啡厅、工作室，让客人选购、欣赏当地设计师作品，感受艺术气息。瑞典最古老的酒店，保留了旧式风格与古董摆设；芷珮登上天台钟楼，还初尝烟熏鹿心，更添神秘感。

programme.title: 玩转香港日与夜粤
programme.desc: 大埔经过多年发展，成为现代化新市镇，但沙螺洞的一条客家村落，却保存了超过三百年乡土风情。建于1913年的火车站，记载着本港铁路发展历程，刘佩玥、翟威廉、沈卓盈入内「试乘」不同年代的列车。松仔园树林茂密得不见天日，凤园保育区成为逾二百种蝴蝶的理想家园。来到庭园餐厅享用特色多国菜，悠闲程度直逼泰国芭堤雅！三人及后到访旧大埔警署，目的竟是学习绿色有机生活？他们前往三门仔欣赏日落美景，可惜天气不似预期……

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 谷主泳嘉、凯文是同届「香港小姐」出身，她们乐于与滢仴一同谈论选美话题并分享经验。著名的「美国小姐」选美已有逾百年历史，其诞生原因是为振兴当地旅游业？众谷主除了讨论泳衣环节是否必需外，还就港姐可加设的新奖项，发挥创意。由TVB主办的香港小姐竞选自1973年起举办至今，每届都有不同特色。泳嘉、凯文忆述参选点滴，并感恩这段经历令她们获益良多。谷主滢仴没有参选港姐，并选择报读艺训班，又有甚么原因？

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 煮东煮西粤
programme.desc: 炒鲜奶菜式好复杂？对东厨黄亚保来说只是家常菜，而鲜奶等材料「铲」至半凝固状态就要上碟！及后用两只鸡炮制「浓鸡汤浸菜胆鸡」，试食组主持之一黄翠如听到步骤都觉困难。西厨莫家嘉将小朋友未必喜欢的毛豆加进肉饼馅内，并以火腿粒和脆鸡皮「转移视线」，变为人见人爱的美食。接着用剪刀沿鸡翼骨位剪几下，弄成鸡翼波波。鸡肉要炸两次的说法，原来有科学支持？此外，帮厨支喾仪花心机处理桃胶，带来养颜甜品「椰皇桃胶炖蛋白」。

programme.title: 煮东煮西粤
programme.desc: 这集呈献龙虾宴，保哥带来「酥炸燕麦片龙虾球」，炸物要挺身香脆，油温、炸浆都有学问。牛奶、燕麦片是好拍档，家嘉配合龙虾、牛油果制成低卡料理。牛油果取肉后怕氧化，可将核同放？荔枝当小食，没洗手的翠如为星厨们搣荔枝，被洁癖陈自瑶厌弃！去壳龙虾钳啖啖肉，配花雕蛋白，保哥见美女们偷食「无贡献」，突击考验连诗雅埋芡。家嘉巧制番茄天使面，注入帮厨颜志恒所熬龙虾汤，香浓味美。喾仪另奉上清热「莲藕红豆陈肾排骨汤」。

programme.title: 全城一叮粤
programme.desc: 初选最后登场的黄润成会表演打鼓，还将装修工具变成音乐节奏，有观众却被电锯吓到揿叮……十六个晋级单位将以一对一形式对垒，最高分者成为总台主。刘芷玲在音乐盒里「觉醒」，以青春舞蹈掀起决赛序幕。对手刘家聪以静制动，用沙画传承爱，鼓励大家换个角度面对人生阻碍。接着带来前「港姐」的歌舞大战，姜嘉琳知道家人对其演艺路向感忧心，借着舞台诉心声。谢采芝则化身「饿狼」，跳唱狂野本色，惟中段曾甩嘴，可会影响战局？

programme.title: 声级学堂粤
programme.desc: 入选「声级学堂」首阶段的一百位学员，正式开学！首席导师黄凤英传授基础配音理论后，翌日举行第二阶段甄选，每人只得One Take机会，紧张指数爆灯！众学员分别声演《反黑路人甲》的黑帮头目「蒋世龙」、在《盖世豪侠》兼饰「忠奸人」的吴孟达、「刻薄导游」汤盈盈与「无知港女」王君馨，有人更化身「星爷」配音？导师点评大家表现，懒音竟是普遍参赛者的通病？经过「拣蟀」，二十强亦告产生，晋级学员将接受更严格特训……

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤
programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 后空翻少年粤日
programme.desc: 经过一番练习，翔太郎通过测试，成为男子韵律体操队的正选，为了追上大家，翔太郎最近都在努力不懈地练习。就在不久，在志田教练安排下，苍秀馆高中校队即将与白鸣大附属高中进行共同集训。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 这次「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，由教练Taby姐姐引领大家锻练敏捷力与反应，并强化心肺功能。学员要听从指令，迅速做出拍手、跨步等动作，对反应能力是一大考验。主持彤彤姐姐自荐负责发号施令，众人又能否跟得上她的节奏？透过原地跑、弓箭步深蹲、高抬腿等动作锻练心肺耐力，彤彤姐姐直言双腿酸软，可见训练并不轻松。「动物好萌友」环节，会介绍英国短毛猫「佛佛」。牠为了玩逗猫棒而躺在地上翻身，模样相当可爱。

programme.title: 成语动画廊粤
programme.desc: 《成语动画廊》以动画手法解说汉语成语的教育片，通过趣味浓厚的动画，让大家分享中国文化的独有宝藏。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子与小玉对花轮的家很有兴趣，花轮便爽快邀请小丸子等人出席他的派对。花轮的大宅气派非凡，令小丸子一行看得目瞪口呆。这天花轮的朋友也会到来，于是小丸子也为他准备了礼物，结果却令小丸子出乎意料！

programme.title: 这十年幸福中国粤
programme.desc: 本片从城市到乡村，以科技、社会、民生、体育、文化等多个角度出发，用小故事展现大主题、用小视角透视大时代，记录各行各业普通人的工作与生活，体现幸福是奋斗出来的思想。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 新闻透视粤
programme.desc: 《新闻透视》，每周专题报道多段香港以至国际的瞩目新闻，聚焦港人最关心的民生话题，并邀请各界人士、学者、专家，一同深入探讨个中来龙去脉。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 女神玩转嘉年华粤
programme.desc: 男士激玩「天旋地转」机动游戏后，抱起女神走过石春路，再讲出记熟的心意告白。本想弃权的焌尧，获芷晴以「愿望」激励，勇气大增。展望被挑战「全速版」，仍一字不漏深情表白，蒨文冧爆！按照题目做动作考默契，各对CP都有心有灵犀的时刻，唯独「欢喜冤家」家俊与嘉敏是例外？口咬意粉传豆腐，亲密互动疯狂放闪。启进、敏巧默契依旧；俊其、毓仪连番失手，Bob看不过眼，竟乱入要与男方试玩……总结多轮比拼，哪对CP最合拍？

programme.title: 守护香港：禁毒60年粤
programme.desc: 「毒品害人，影响一生」，1950年代香港贩毒和吸毒问题严重， 毒品不仅推高犯罪率、破坏家庭，更对公共衞生造成沉重负担，有见及此，政府于1965年成立禁毒常务委员会，60年来持续与社会各界携手抵御毒祸。由推行美沙酮戒毒计划，到大力打击依托咪酯，作为香港政府的禁毒咨询组织，禁毒常务委员会多年来如何在打击毒品方面，为政府出谋献策，并动员社区力量呢？「守护香港：禁毒60年」有详细介绍。

programme.title: 无间一战粤PG
programme.desc: 弟弟彭健诚是毒枭集团的头目，而哥哥彭健忠则是一位缉毒警察，双方同时卷入到一场毒枭斗争中，随着一场押送毒贩的任务，哥哥发现弟弟竟然另有身份，二人为了各自的目的，展开了一场正邪交锋，无间反转的缉毒故事

programme.title: J Sport粤
programme.desc: 长跑女将屈旨盈正为香港马拉松积极备战，她细谈参赛目标，还会为跑友送上实用贴士。香港国际马术盛典将召集逾三十个国家及地区的骑手，展开顶尖对垒。大会还首次引入狗狗障碍挑战赛，场地周边也提供不同娱乐与活动，为观众带来精彩体验。少年剑击精英赛早前在澳门举行，两位中国名将雷声、邓小浩到场力撑，并向小剑手分享经验。本地篮球好手郑锦兴出席青年运动员颁奖礼，藉自身经历勉励新一代篮儿勇于追梦。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤 及 天气报告粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 财经透视粤
programme.desc: 《财经透视》紧贴大市，回顾每周港股走势外，并关注楼市状况，透过业界人士专访、市场分析等，深入浅出探讨本港、国际财经金融热门话题，更以专题形式报道不同行业发展面对的问题。

programme.title: 新鲜人#25粤PG
programme.desc: (大结局)唱婆逝世，丽华伤心不巳。家谦得知韦文曾为自己不断付出，十分感动，但命运弄人，二人终天各一方。1999年的圣诞，众人为家谦的演奏会聚首。家谦心里极渴望韦文出现。韦文返港，发现阮盈的信及家谦字条，恍然大悟，即赶赴演奏厅，惜途中遇意外。家谦像是有所感应，改了原本演奏乐曲，改而演奏韦文亲自替他谱上歌词的乐章，众人深受感动。岁月流逝，韦文和家谦有情人终成眷属，而家辉及家谦皆随各自的努力而有所成就。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 沙特阿拉伯最具代表性的款待文化, 其中咖啡就被视为接待客人最佳的礼物 用铜经过敲打、打磨等多重工序制作而成的阿拉伯咖啡壶 - 达拉对沙特人来说是蕴含悠久历史和传统的手工艺品

programme.title: 世界独特社区粤普
programme.desc: 越南筒房是因人口暴涨，抢夺居住空间所衍生出的独特建筑风格。房间建筑空间狭长而深，巧妙避开了以横向宽度的高税收。丹麦社区农圃, 提供一种粮食自给, 互助和合作的生活方式, 试图打破都市住民彼此间的隔阂。

programme.title: 彼得与狼奇遇记

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【王牌律师X怪物新人法律界最强拍档真相一触即发！】在韩国顶尖律师事务所KANG&HAM，崔江锡是无人能敌的王牌律师，精准果敢、战无不胜。一次偶然，他遇见高延宇──没有法学背景、未取得律师执照，却拥有怪物般的惊人记忆力。慧眼识珠的江锡破格将他纳入团队，从此两人成为法律界最强黄金拍档。在法庭上纵横捭阖、揭露真相与阴谋，他们并肩作战，也建立深厚情谊，并在爱与抉择间踏上命运的新篇章。

programme.title: 追踪者
programme.desc: 【国税厅版文森佐任时完热血复仇】全台首播，任职于顶尖会计事务所的黄东柱，实力超群，年纪轻轻就坐上组长的位子，在父亲坠海身亡以意外结案后，整理遗物的东柱发现，纪录大企业逃税的本子凭空消失了，他火速考上地方国税局。靠著揭发知名球星的逃税案，立马成为国税局的当红炸子鸡，本以为能离真相更近，却被调职到「国税厅5局」，这个被大家称作垃圾场的单位，而他又该如何率领团队深入调查，找到真正的杀父仇人呢?

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 红天机

programme.desc: 【霸道总裁《飞狐外传》林雨申恋上俏邻居《光芒》蔡文静！】吴忧因车祸意外放男友鸽子惨遭分手，而同样在这场车祸中丧命的是雅曼生物科技总裁何西亚的未婚妻陆芸。吴忧分手后寄情于工作，投入新职场认识了陆芸的妹妹陆蔓，成为了闺蜜。在公事上与何西亚有了合作，不打不相识的这对欢喜冤家，好不容易发展成为恋人,此时发现陆芸在他们之间串连起来的缘分…

programme.title: 森林侦探
programme.desc: 韩国教育电视台EBS制作的寓教于乐卡通，可轻松认识大自然的样貌。神秘事件在森林里发生，栗子莫名消失，昆虫朋友离奇失踪，皮特、巴巴、茉莉对这些事件展开调查。带著侦探精神一起度过难关，在繁忙的调查过程中，共同学习、共同成长，创造学习乐趣。

programme.title: 呱张爆音团
programme.desc: 12岁的柯阿瑞和他的三个好朋友一起在车库里成立了一支乐队，但是很快的他们就发现他们的乐队很烂-真的很烂。问题不在他们的音乐或是百变造型，而是因为柯阿瑞写不出歌词。他就是想不出酷炫的歌词嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日记。「哇！这里面不只废话连篇，还有满满的青少年烦恼。」柯阿瑞和乐队「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日记作为他们的创作新曲的歌词–结果你知道怎么样吗？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，当然演出机会也越来越多了！这样一来就皆大欢喜了，对吗？才怪。翠娜是个超级讨人厌的恰查某，完全无法忍受她弟弟的烂乐队比她还要红。她想尽办法要来粉碎他们的梦想。但没关系啦。柯阿瑞很了解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子里的蛔虫一样。柯阿瑞总是知道该怎么做才能让翠娜炸毛，然后生出他们最欠缺的东西......歌词！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的乐团嗨翻天吧！看他们为达目的怎么不择手段的恶搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 豆小鸭
programme.desc: 单纯直率的豆小鸭总是不小心闯祸，还好他有最棒的好朋友－－善解人意的袋熊沃蓓，和热爱发明的小猪奇姆！只要三个人在一起，不管遇到任何困难，都能运用创意找到有趣的方法解决，把日常生活的所有危机，变成精彩好玩的大冒险！快快快，一起来山谷洞玩吧！

programme.desc: 12岁的柯阿瑞和他的三个好朋友一起在车库里成立了一支乐队，但是很快的他们就发现他们的乐队很烂-真的很烂。问题不在他们的音乐或是百变造型，而是因为柯阿瑞写不出歌词。他就是想不出酷炫的歌词嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日记。「哇！这里面不只废话连篇，还有满满的青少年烦恼。」柯阿瑞和乐队「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日记作为他们的创作新曲的歌词–结果你知道怎么样吗？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，当然演出机会也越来越多了！这样一来就皆大欢喜了，对吗？才怪。翠娜是个超级讨人厌的恰查某，完全无法忍受她弟弟的烂乐队比她还要红。她想尽办法要来粉碎他们的梦想。但没关系啦。柯阿瑞很了解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子里的蛔虫一样。柯阿瑞总是知道该怎么做才能让翠娜炸毛，然后生出他们最欠缺的东西......歌词！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的乐团嗨翻天吧！看他们为达目的怎么不择手段的恶搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 最佳爱情
programme.desc: 【知名编剧「洪氏姊妹」执笔当红VS过气偶像间的恋爱罗曼史】正值演艺巅峰的独孤振，不但是广告界宠儿，更是国民好感度第一的男星！而具爱贞则是前当红偶像团体「国宝少女」成员，因过气只好跑跑通告维持生计。独孤振在一次试镜中，因英语程度不佳，丢失了出演机会，没想到这丢人的秘密，居然被具爱贞给知道了！国民喜爱的男星碰上国民唾弃的女星，他们能克服众人的偏见勇敢去爱吗?一场荒谬又有趣的浪漫恋曲即将展开。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣领
programme.desc: 【改编荣获韩国网路小说悬疑类大奖，热血记者金荷娜携手前男友延玗臻联手调查！】擅长挖掘独家新闻的女记者徐贞媛，除事业上的成功，与作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚后生活也令人称羡。某日在犯罪现场成为了目击者，随著越演越烈的风波被怀疑为杀人犯，为证明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰宪寻求帮助，联手找寻真相。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 奇迹的兄弟
programme.desc: 【《高斯电子公司》裴贤圣不当高富帅，与《精神教练诸葛吉》郑宇奇迹相遇】负债累累的热血青年陆东柱，在以为是人生中最糟糕的一天遇上了特殊神力却来历不明名为「奇迹」的少年。能够深刻感受别人痛苦与绝望，也能治愈别人。为找回他的过去与记忆，两人成为了彼此生命中的一个奇迹相遇。

programme.title: 向风而行
programme.desc: 【《请叫我总监》谭松韵与《清平乐》王凯，飞向天际携手筑梦！！】鹭洲航空客运飞行部副部长顾南亭因公司改制，与性格飒爽不羁的程霄成为上下属和师徒关系。面对接踵而来的突发航空事件，追求稳定秩序的顾南亭时常被不按常理出牌的程霄打乱计划，共同经历冲击与考验，一路披荆斩棘、相扶成长。

programme.title: 时光之城
programme.desc: 【横跨两国人气演员的偶像剧，张哲瀚携手朴敏英初尝试爱情罗曼史！！】乐观积极的元气少女许真，在前往盖亚影视应征时撞见了当红炸子鸡顾持钧被前女友拒绝的场面。不希望丢脸的事情曝光的顾持钧则从中作梗想赶走许真，却阴错阳差的在盖亚集团二公子林晋修的帮助下，反而成为了顾持钧的助理。朝夕相处、情愫蔓延，却同时卷入了集团的阴谋，两人要如何逃出危机，让有情人终成眷属呢?

programme.title: 爱情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永携手《社内相亲》薛仁雅寻找幸福小确幸！！！】清雅是一名放弃恋爱和结婚，努力在生活中，连续八年准备警察公务员却无法合格的社会小螺丝。俊辉则是一名对他人毫无兴趣的不婚主义者，不管是爱情、友情还是亲情都秉持N分之一的态度。认识了彼此开始寻找琐碎但现实的小确幸，并开始认知爱情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 韶华若锦
programme.desc: 【宋威龙x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚后爱的夫妻生活！！】冷面战神定北王江绪因调查北军军饷贪墨案回到大显王朝，没想到贪墨案背后牵连甚广，为了尽快查明真相，他自愿迎娶将门之女明檀，让明家免遭利用。两人先婚后爱，相处过程中逐渐产生情愫，并且联手揭露朝堂阴谋，经历坎坷后双向收获的美好爱情。

programme.desc: Bluey, Snickers, and Winton are on their way to ask Calypso for help with their problems, when they are ambushed by the Terriers and use their unique talents to get past.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Super Sandcastle
programme.desc: Supertato and the Veggies have built a super sandcastle, but Evil Pea wants to storm it by firing her hordes of Mini Peas at it with her pea shooter.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Pen Pal Badge
programme.desc: Duggee arranges for the Squirrels to write to some pen pals.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Big Day Out Badge
programme.desc: Duggee takes the Squirrels and their parents on an exciting mystery trip.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Calm Down
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Parthenon, Greece
programme.desc: Inspired by his favourite action film, Grand Master Glitch plans to make a blockbuster of his own, but first he needs to find the right setting for an action adventure.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are off to see the Geysers in Iceland, but Grandmaster Glitch and the Grimbots have beaten them to it, and managed to get themselves stuck in the Geysers.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Tarbela Dam, Pakistan
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch gets his hands on a G.O. Force, the forecast isn't good for the Tarbela Dam in Pakistan.

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S4) - Holly's Merseyside Scouse and Crusty Bread
programme.desc: Holly prepares a special recipe from Liverpool, scouse with crusty bread.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Grizzly Bear Cubs
programme.desc: In this episode Andy, Jen &amp; Scout head to Alaska, in America, on a baby animal mission to solve the mystery of fish being buried underground. Along the way, Andy meets a grizzly bear cub setting out on its first fishing trip with its mother to catch salmon.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S8) - Seaweed's Scrub Rap
programme.desc: In this episode Captain Captain gives the pirates the not-so-exciting job of scrubbing the ship's pots and pans, but thanks to Seaweed's brainwave they turn it into a world of musical fun!

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Flying Horse Crazy
programme.desc: Amelia is flying around in the toy shop when suddenly she notices the toy flying horse.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Bumpy And The Wise Old Wolfhound
programme.desc: Bingo is sick in hospital, so Bluey and Dad sent her a homemade video to lift her spirits. It tells the tale of Barnicus' quest to heal her spotty dog named Bumpy.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Asparagus
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey to mind her manners at the table - they're not animals. But when Bluey gets her hands on a stick of magic asparagus, she shows them everyone's got a wild side.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Dump
programme.desc: On a trip to the Dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Tablet Takeover
programme.desc: The Veggies are delighted with a new tablet they've found. When they're not looking, Evil Pea turns the tablet to evil mode. Soon the tablet takes over the supermarket.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: One of the great Kung-fu film characters is "Beggar Su", a legendary Ching Dynasty figure who was also a member of the famous Ten Kwangtung Tigers. Little-known director Liu Shih-yu uses the best Kung-fu actors Shaw Studios had to offer to tell a rare, colorful, action-packed adventure, as Beggar Su and his brother train incessantly to defeat the brutally powerful thief called Centipede.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao's chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous "Twin Swords" in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the "sick people of Asia" and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Fans of the international star Alexander Fu Sheng were aghast. Their idol had broken both his legs and was recuperating. Everyone wondered: would he be able to return to the action comedies for which he was so famous? This movie was the answer, and it left no doubt that he had made a full recovery. Liu Chia-yung, brother of preeminent martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang, was famous in his own right for kung-fu comedies, and he out-did himself with this one.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma's pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief's daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily found help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Truth: Final Episode
programme.desc: Raymond's lawyer licence is suspended as he has prevented the course of justice to clear his mother's conviction. He is subsequently framed for murder with every piece of evidence pointing towards him. The only one with proof of his innocence is his dying mother, who fights to stay alive long enough to exonerate her son before it is too late.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Where Have All The Stars Gone?

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Make Music For Mimi?
programme.desc: Mimi has lost the handle to her music box and can't hear her music. Jess works out how to make instruments and get all the friends involved in making a little orchestra and performing a fantastic song to cheer mimi up.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Find Sammy Snail?
programme.desc: Jess helps Mimi to find her little frend Sammy Snail who's gone missing. They check all the places she's seen him before and work out that if they follow the silvery train it leads right to him.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Won't My Kite Fly?
programme.desc: Jess is given his very first kite by Mimi. It's very special indeed. He can't wait to fly it! But first he has to work out HOW!

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Did A Dandelion Seed Get Into Mimi's Garden?
programme.desc: Mimi is shocked to find a dandelion plant in her lovely pink and purple garden. She didn't plant it there herself, so how on earth did the dandelion get there? Jess is determined to find out and in the process they work out how some seeds are transported by birds, some in the coats of animals and some in the wind. Jess says goodbye and asks the children to see how many different types of seeds and flowers they can spot.

programme.desc: Bands on the Run Casper and Jimmy form a rock band to compete in the Deedstown Battle of the Bands. Vote for Casper Mantha is angling to win the office of Class Rep, but Kibosh fancies having a fellow ghost in power.

They each pick a plant to take care of, and for Kelp it’s a sad, almost dead plant that he falls in love with.

programme.desc: Tag wants to do something special for her Mom and Paw’s anniversary, so she recreates the boat cruise where her parents first met. \ Tag discovers that nothing is planned for Pawston’s 100th birthday, so she decides the town needs to rebuild the old Bonestand for a big Pawston concert.

Having moved to England from Monaco in 2006, Adebayor went on to score 97 Premier League goals in 242 appearances in a career spanning spells at Arsenal, Tottenham Hotspur, Manchester City and Crystal Palace.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP30
programme.desc: Three decades on from Manchester United's iconic Class of '92, PL Stories steps beyond the headline names to rediscover the teammates who shared the same dressing room, dreams, and demands of one of football's most revered youth systems. We sit down with the lesser-known graduates who lived that journey first-hand, players whose paths diverged from the global spotlight but whose experiences offer a rare and revealing window into the reality behind the legend.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP22
programme.desc: From rural Brittany to the Premier League, Georginio Rutter has come a long way from the quiet streets of Plescop in North West France. Now a central figure in Brighton's hunt for continental qualification, Rutter's journey has seen him play in both Ligue 1 and the Bundesliga, as well as being a transfer record signing for both Leeds and the Seagulls.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP26
programme.desc: We sit down for an exclusive interview with the first of two new Premier League Hall of fame inductees, Eden Hazard. A celebrated footballer who lit up the English top-flight during his illustrious career; a winner of multiple domestic and European honours, he became a true legend of the Premier League era. He reflects on his rise to the top, the moments that defined his career, and the immense pride he feels at joining the elite ranks of the Premier League's greatest ever players.

programme.desc: Find out how the flavours of China have come to be such an integral part of the cuisine of Singapore.

programme.title: Backpack - Coimbra, Portgual
programme.desc: From an ancient monastery and center of learning to one of the world’s oldest universities, welcome to Coimbra, Portugal’s university town.

programme.title: Off The Grid - Nubra Valley, Ladakh, India

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka - Mirissa
programme.desc: The host tries whale watching in Mirissa, goes on a bike tour in Wellawaya and explores tea gardens in Ella..

programme.title: Xplore Belgium - Antwerp 1
programme.desc: Known as Belgium’s capital of cool, Antwerp has long been a powerful magnet for different kinds of people from diamond dealers to fashion moguls.

programme.title: World Spas - Mines Wellness, Malaysia
programme.desc: Jamie Srubis tries many rejuvenating spa treatments belonging to Ayurveda and Traditional Chinese Medicine, at Mines Wellness Resort in Malaysia.

programme.title: Food Stories - Indian
programme.desc: From fish head curry to ‘Rojak’, why do visitors from India in Singapore find it difficult to identify with the Indian dishes in the country?

programme.title: Backpack - Porto, Portgual
programme.desc: Driek soaks in the old-world atmosphere of Porto and sets out to sample the city’s famous port wine.

programme.title: Off The Grid - Kargil, India
programme.desc: From a Sikh Gurudwara to an organization devoted to the betterment of Ladakhi people, Alex finds herself inspired by the humanity in Kargil.

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka - Polonnaruwa
programme.desc: The host learns about the traditions, beliefs and history of Sri Lanka in the ancient cities of Kandy, Polonnaruwa and Sigiriya.

programme.title: Xplore Belgium - Antwerp 2
programme.desc: Being the latest European hipster hub, with an avant garde cultural scene, doesn’t stop Antwerp from boasting of its rich and interesting history.

programme.title: Unwind - Park Hyatt, Maldives
programme.desc: Indeya Passfield seeks local Maldivian experiences in Hadahaa, where she learns about the ecosystem, local traditions and cuisine.

programme.title: Food Stories - Malay

programme.title: Backpack - Douro Valley, Portgual

programme.title: Off The Grid - Suru Valley, India

programme.title: Kissed By The Sea - Valletta, Malta
programme.desc: Tara Sumner loses herself in the ornate Baroque legacy left by the Knights of St. John in Valletta, the capital of Malta.

programme.desc: Indeya Passfield visits Vabbinfaru island, a hidden tropical gem just 20 minutes away from Male, the bustling capital of Maldives.

programme.title: Heritage - Stonehenge
programme.desc: Located in the ceremonial county of Wiltshire in South West England is the prehistoric, Stonehenge Avebury. A 'henge monument'…Stonehenge literally means 'menhirs' or upright monumental stones

programme.title: Landmarks - Verinag

programme.desc: From stumbling upon a statue of Guru Rinpoche to attending a local festival at a monastery, Alex explores the influence of Buddhism in Zanskar Valley.

programme.title: Kissed By The Sea - Comino, Malta
programme.desc: Azure waters, white sandy beaches, Mediterranean charm and a riveting history make Malta the perfect destination for an island getaway.

programme.title: Xplore Belgium - Brussels

programme.title: City Breaks - Cologne
programme.desc: Cologne is all things romantic from the chocolate museum to its perfume shop. It is a city in love with life, one that knows how to have a good time.

programme.title: Bliss - Cappadocia, Turkey
programme.desc: Turkey is a perfect place for some adventure and old charm with rugged landscapes, carved castles and varied mezze. Hot air balloon is an attractive sport done by all visitor.

programme.title: Best From The Rest - Mauritius; Experience The Romance
programme.desc: To avoid your love life become captive of mundane, we suggest adding a whimsical element to it. Presenting, five best experiences which you can savor together in Mauritius with your "special" someone.

programme.desc: The host visits the iconic sights of Colombo, and goes on to take a river safari and visit a turtle hatchery in Bentota.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP39
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP8
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP24
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP5
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP5
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP7
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.title: Shades of Life - EP2
programme.desc: Ko Ba-dou (Yu Yang), a retired school principal with a deep love for traditional Chinese culture, values ​​family ethics and is highly respected by his family. His eldest son, Ko Ho-pan (Wu Nuoyan), a journalism graduate and magazine editor, is a prodigy who seeks to get to the bottom of things. On livelihood issues, he occasionally disagrees with his father, holding different views.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP15
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Bottled Passion - EP7
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.

programme.title: The Defected - EP29
programme.desc: Inspector Sheung-bang of the Crime Squad was once a rising star in the police force. While trying to save a colleague, he was shot by a gangster, his life forever changed. programme.title: The Price Of Greed - EP1
programme.desc: Police Constable LUI TO (WONG CHUNG CHAK, BOSCO) is shocked to discover that TSU FUNG (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL), who has reportedly gone missing for a year, is already dead and that his body has been claimed by his girlfriend LAM PING (TSUI KATE TSZ SHAN). Then, suddenly and mysteriously, FUNG, who is believed to be dead, turns up again, which makes the enigma even more intriguing. The relationship between PING and FUNG is also put to the test amidst such confusion.

programme.title: 2025全球数商大会｜信任为基 数据为核——共建现代服务业可信数据流通基础设施
programme.desc: 致力于打造成为企业数字化转型与数据资产建设的核心服务载体。通过充分发挥空间集聚与纽带功能，积极整合技术、资本、人才等产业要素，构建协同共生的服务业数据产业生态。平台旨在系统性解决企业在数据应用中的实际难题，助力企业真正实现“有数可用、有数敢用”，持续赋能业务创新与高质量发展。

programme.title: 2025全球数商大会｜“申城·数聚行”投融资论坛

programme.title: 直播丨Bio+学院“扬帆出海”系列主题直播课·第八期 扬帆拓海 药通全球
programme.desc: 为助力本土企业精准把握国际药政新动向，打通创新药械海外注册全链条，构建符合国际标准的临床试验质量管理体系，本期直播课聚焦新形势下上海创新药出海的战略布局、临床试验管理与注册实操，集结复宏汉霖、泰格医药、辉瑞三大头部药企的相关领域专家，深度解码出海核心难题，为企业国际化征程提供“精准导航”。\r\n上海市生物医药产业教育培训平台“Bio+学院”联合行业龙头企业和知名专家,倾力打造“扬帆出海”主题系列直播课,将从政策法规、行业规划、产品准入、市场监管等方面,为企业深度答疑解惑,促进跨境交流，推动多边合作。\r\n后续敬请期待!

programme.desc: 本次论坛汇聚司法界、学术界、产业界代表，围绕数据权益司法保护与数字规则立法等核心议题展开深入交流。与专家共同探讨数字技术发展中的法治保障机制，分享全球数字治理经验与国内创新实践，为推动建立适应数字时代的法治框架、促进数字经济在法治轨道上健康有序发展贡献智慧与力量。

programme.title: 2025全球数商大会｜数链生态 智启未来——第二届区块链创新高峰论坛
programme.desc: 论坛聚焦区块链技术与产业深度融合的创新实践，探讨如何结合人工智能、物联网等前沿技术构建安全高效的数据智能流通体系。邀请技术专家、行业领袖，从多元主体需求出发，深入解析区块链在政务、金融、医疗、供应链等关键领域的应用场景与价值潜力，共同探索区块链技术赋能城市功能升级与治理现代化的创新路径，为智慧城市建设注入新动能。
